title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition

title: Immutable Strings in Java – Are Your Secrets Still Safe?
summary: Java programmers might not be aware their secrets could be floating around in system memory long after it's assumed those secrets have been removed. title: The Case for a Vulnerability Operations Center
summary: Vulnerability remediation has become an execution problem. Security teams are generating more findings than ever, but too often those findings do not translate into timely risk reduction. The gap between newly introduced exposure and effective remediation continues to widen. Addressing that gap requires more than improved scanning, better dashboards, or additional tooling. It requires a dedicated operating model. This is the role of the Vulnerability Operations Center, or VOC.
